postconditions: The exact file-reporting and NETCONF/YANG profiles are active; every lifecycle requestFixture resolves to the registered immutable XML bytes.
Profile-pinned NETCONF readback is UNLOCKED and operationalState reaches ENABLED within the profile timeout.
One commit-eligible record can be captured per policy cell without fixing values or timestamps.

retries.policy: declared-timeout-and-backoff only; no implicit retry and no hidden sleep on the request path
